label: F/A-18C Hornet (DCS DTC)
pathSyntax: Dot-separated keys of the .dtc "data" object. "[]" = any array index, "{}" = any object key, each as its own segment (e.g. WYPT.NAV_PTS.[].x, WYPT.NAV_ROUTE.[].{}.ETA, ALR67.RWR.NORM.{}.PRI). An array is user-extensible only when its section has a "template"; "maxItems"/"fixedLength" bound it. Sections marked hidden cover a whole derived/internal subtree. "display" = {unit, factor}: shown value = stored value * factor. For strings "maxLength" is the cockpit/UI limit. Templates carry row-1 values; the exporter renumbers wypt_num/num and re-derives every id (see derived).
source: DCS 2.9.30.28738 CoreMods/aircraft/FA-18C/DTC (FA-18C_hornet_DTC.lua; threat base = CoreMods/aircraft/F-16C/DTC/threat_base.lua, 123 groups); see native-FA-18C.md, native-FA-18C-threats.json and EXPORT-NOTES.md

fields.label: Cartridge name
fields.help: Informational inside data; DCS indexes cartridges by the outer .dtc "name". The exporter writes the same string here, in the outer name and in the file name DTC/<name>.dtc. Must not contain * / ? < > | \ : " and is trimmed by the ME.

fields.label: Aircraft type
fields.help: Must be exactly "FA-18C_hornet" (both data.type and the outer type). Any other value makes setData reset to defaults and load nothing; an unknown outer type crashes the ME.

fields.label: Theatre
fields.help: Theatre id of the mission (miz "theatre", e.g. Caucasus, PersianGulf, Syria). If it differs from the theatre the cartridge is loaded on, steerpoints, route sequences, GPS waypoints and TACAN stations are silently skipped.

fields.label: Waypoint theatre
fields.help: Copy of the theatre id. setData never reads it (it uses the top-level terrain); the exporter writes the same value.

fields.label: Do not upload steerpoints and route sequences
fields.help: DTC checkbox "Do not upload tab data" (default checked = true). Inverted: true means the steerpoints AND the three route sequences are NOT loaded into the jet. The exporter writes false whenever the plan has a route.

fields.label: Steerpoint id
fields.help: Derived: "STPT" + wypt_num. Rebuilt by setData.

fields.label: Waypoint number
fields.help: Steerpoint number in the HSI/WYPT sequence (1-59, holes allowed, unique). Missing value throws in setData.

fields.label: Map X (north)
fields.help: DCS map X in metres (north). Converted from the plan latitude/longitude with the theatre projection.

fields.label: Map Y (east)
fields.help: DCS map Z in metres (east), stored as y.

fields.label: Elevation
fields.help: Steerpoint altitude in metres (MSL or AGL per altitudeType). The jet and the DTC UI show feet (alt / 0.3048); UI range -2000..25000 ft. Import default is 2000 m when missing.

fields.label: Note
fields.help: Free text shown in the DTC grid "note" column. Not displayed in the jet.

fields.label: Text label
fields.help: Steerpoint text label (5 characters max, the UI cuts longer text; case kept).

fields.label: In route sequence 1
fields.help: Point belongs to route sequence 1 (SEQ 1). Every flagged point needs a plan in WYPT.NAV_ROUTE[0]; routes 2 and 3 are not auto-created on load.

fields.label: Position in route sequence 1
fields.help: 1-based order of the point in SEQ 1 (max 15 per sequence). Only read when R1 is true (the exporter omits it otherwise; a missing order sorts last). Must match the plan order and be 1..n without gaps.

fields.label: In route sequence 2
fields.help: Point belongs to route sequence 2 (SEQ 2). Every flagged point needs a plan in WYPT.NAV_ROUTE[1]; routes 2 and 3 are not auto-created on load.

fields.label: Position in route sequence 2
fields.help: 1-based order of the point in SEQ 2 (max 15 per sequence). Only read when R2 is true (the exporter omits it otherwise; a missing order sorts last). Must match the plan order and be 1..n without gaps.

fields.label: In route sequence 3
fields.help: Point belongs to route sequence 3 (SEQ 3). Every flagged point needs a plan in WYPT.NAV_ROUTE[2]; routes 2 and 3 are not auto-created on load.

fields.label: Position in route sequence 3
fields.help: 1-based order of the point in SEQ 3 (max 15 per sequence). Only read when R3 is true (the exporter omits it otherwise; a missing order sorts last). Must match the plan order and be 1..n without gaps.

fields.label: Altitude reference
fields.help: Reference of alt. Mirrored into the route plan.

fields.label: Speed reference
fields.help: How the planned speed is flown/displayed. Default 3 (ground speed).

fields.label: Offset aimpoint (OAP) set
fields.help: Steerpoint has an offset aimpoint. When false, write every OA_* number as 0.

fields.label: OAP range
fields.help: Range steerpoint -> OAP in metres (UI 0..400000 ft). Derived from OA_X/OA_Y; edit range and bearing and let the exporter compute OA_X/OA_Y.

fields.label: OAP bearing (true)
fields.help: Bearing steerpoint -> OAP in degrees TRUE (atan2 in the DCS map frame). The UI "°M" label is display-only; no magnetic variation is applied.

fields.label: OAP elevation
fields.help: Absolute OAP elevation in metres MSL as stored by the DTC UI (terrain elevation at the OAP). The cockpit OAP page shows elevation in feet.

fields.label: OAP map X
fields.help: Derived: x + OA_Range * cos(OA_Bearing).

fields.label: OAP map Y
fields.help: Derived: y + OA_Range * sin(OA_Bearing).

fields.label: OAP delta X
fields.help: Derived: x - OA_X.

fields.label: OAP delta Y
fields.help: Derived: y - OA_Y.

fields.label: OAP bearing display unit
fields.help: DTC UI display label only; the stored bearing is always true.

fields.label: OAP range display unit
fields.help: DTC UI display unit only; the stored range is always metres.

fields.label: OAP elevation display unit
fields.help: DTC UI display unit only; the stored elevation is always metres.

fields.label: OAP map id
fields.help: Derived: "OA" + wypt_num. Write it explicitly; the import default uses the array index instead.

fields.label: OAP line map id
fields.help: Derived: "OA" + wypt_num + "Line".

fields.label: Route number
fields.help: Index of the sequence this plan belongs to (1-3). Copied as-is on import; write it.

fields.label: Waypoint number
fields.help: Integer wypt_num of the NAV_PTS entry (never the string "STPT<n>"). Missing value throws in setData.

fields.label: Planned altitude
fields.help: Leg altitude in metres (MSL/AGL per altitudeType); import defaults it to 0, so always write it (normally = the point alt). Cockpit shows feet.

fields.label: Altitude reference
fields.help: MSL or AGL for alt.

fields.label: Planned speed (into this point)
fields.help: Speed of the leg arriving at this point, km/h (463 = 250 kt; kt * 1.852). UI clamp 70..1700. With FIX_Time the speed is recomputed from the ETAs.

fields.label: ETA
fields.help: Seconds since 00:00 of the mission date (same base as mission start_time; days allowed). Recomputed on every load unless FIX_Time or TGT is set, from mission start (ME) or the aircraft position (in sim).

fields.label: Fixed time
fields.help: ETA is authoritative and the leg speed is derived from it (clamped 70..1700 km/h).

fields.label: Target point
fields.help: Attack/target point of this sequence; its ETA is the time on target. At most one per sequence.
